panel.title: Brute force: failed logons by source (5m windows, >5)

search.query: index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 | eval src_ip = coalesce(src_ip, IpAddress, "unknown") | bin _time span=5m | stats count by _time, src_ip | where count > 5 | sort - count
index=sysmon EventCode=1 CommandLine=*-enc* | table _time, host, Image, CommandLine
index=sysmon EventCode=13 TargetObject=*Run* | table _time, host, Image, TargetObject
